title: Keystone: Judging Previews at Key Steps for Test-Time Search in Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25530v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion and flow models yield a preview, their clean-image estimate, at every denoising step. When they miscount, drop or misplace objects, test-time search is in a bind: its verifiers are reward models built for finished images, so judging early misreads blurry previews, and judging late, as best-of-N does, pays to fully denoise doomed candidates. We find that the image is not the problem: the outcome is settled as denoising starts, by the seed or by a stochastic sampler's first steps, and already shows in early previews; what fails on them is the judge, as reward models read them near chance on several kinds of prompts. We introduce Keystone, a training-free judge of previews that compiles a prompt into typed questions about its objects, counts, colours and positions and has an off-the-shelf multimodal decision model answer them. Asked this way, the judge reads counts and positions from early previews better than reward

translated_title: Keystone：面向扩散模型测试时搜索的关键步骤预览评判
translated_abstract: 文本到图像的扩散模型和流模型在每一个去噪步骤都会产生一个预览，即其对干净图像的估计。当这些模型出现数量错误、遗漏物体或物体位置摆放错误时，测试时搜索就陷入了困境：它的验证器是为最终完成图像构建的奖励模型，因此早期评判会误读模糊的预览，而像best-of-N那样延后评判，则需要为彻底去噪那些注定失败的候选图像付出代价。我们发现问题并不出在图像本身：去噪一开始，结果就已由种子或随机采样器的最初几步所决定，并且已经在早期预览中显现出来；真正失败的是评判者，因为在多种类型的提示词上，奖励模型读取这些预览的能力接近随机水平。我们提出了Keystone，一个无需训练的预览评判器，它将提示词编译成关于物体、数量、颜色和位置的类型化问题，并让现成的多模态决策模型来回答这些问题。以这种方式提问时，该评判器从早期预览中读取数量和位置的能力优于奖励模型。
tldr: 该论文提出无需训练的预览评判器Keystone，通过将提示词分解为关于物体、数量、颜色和位置的类型化问题并由现成多模态模型回答，使扩散模型测试时搜索能在去噪早期步骤就可靠地识别注定失败的候选，避免浪费算力。
en_tdlr: Keystone is a training-free preview judge that compiles prompts into typed questions about objects, counts, colors, and positions answered by an off-the-shelf multimodal model, enabling test-time search in diffusion models to reliably identify doomed candidates at early denoising steps instead of wasting computation fully denoising them.
